title: Typography / Hierarchy example and calls to action
slide_intent: Make importance and action visible through type relationships so readers can find the main message and recognize what to do next.
strategic_value: An explicit hierarchy and repeatable action treatments can connect Uber’s communication voice to usable interaction cues.
demonstration: The upper-right example relates headline, subhead and logo through measurements. The lower-right matrix compares an action link and a button in inactive and hover/active states.
practical_value: Apply the illustrated headline/subhead relationship and select the stated font for either an action link or a button.

content_islands.name: Hierarchy explanation and specimen
content_islands.spec: Place the hierarchy rationale at upper left; at upper right align measurement notes with the headline, subhead and Uber logo example.

content_islands.name: Call-to-action comparison
content_islands.spec: Place action-type instructions at lower left; at lower right arrange Action and Button columns against Inactive and Hover/Active rows, showing blue link text and blue-to-black button states.

ingredient.name: Type hierarchy and calls to action
ingredient.role: Separate message priority and identify actionable text.
ingredient.application: For the illustrated hierarchy use the stated headline/subhead metrics; use Uber Move Text Bold for Action and Uber Move Display Bold for Buttons.
ingredient.scope: Partner guide hierarchy example, whose headline annotation says six words or more. The page does not explain shorter-headline treatment.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains hierarchy in terms of relative importance through scale and function.
reference_purposes.Expression: The worked headline/subhead and action-state specimens show contrasting size, weight and color.
reference_purposes.Application: The page demonstrates a two-line headline, half-size subhead and two call-to-action treatments.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The example specifies Display Medium headline, minimum 1.5× logo point size, 1.0 leading and zero tracking; Display Light subhead at half headline size, 1.2 leading and zero tracking; logo height equals composition margin width. Actions use Text Bold and buttons use Display Bold.
